close_delta_projection.rule: Display-only projection of verified handoff grade using its stored corrected closes and credited fills; no replay or target changes.

SENTENCE.authorship_scope: Author-token metric excluding prior-only badges, including PRIOR_REWEIGHTED_BY_OWN_WALK; not certification of the Gate-1 own-receipt/weight chain.
SENTENCE.gate_1_reason: Author labels do not independently prove causal own-print weights and own-clock authorship; do not equate the token share with passing Gate 1.

comparison_clock.rule: At bench bell minus gate*60, use each leg's latest stored OS family at or before that epoch; realized family and pool accuracy use the same bench gate. No OS call is recomputed.

ALT.family_call_source: Stored OS belief.family; cascade beliefs carry the selected pool's modal family

GAS.family_call_source: Stored OS belief.family; cascade beliefs carry the selected pool's modal family

MACRO.bench_label: RULING RUN — TICK LIBRARY — CANDIDATE POOL SCOREBOARD
MACRO.ess_source: Bench validity pool, not OS membership ESS

operator_rule.label: Initial macro idea, not the pool's exact family name
operator_rule.role_source: RECOGNITION_OPERATING_POINT @41c1f724: close minus post-formation open; >=+2 CLIMBER, <=-2 FALLER, else NOT_CALLABLE. Use corrected close/open, never stale net_travel.
operator_rule.selection: First recorded directional first_bind inside the corrected span and no later than that side's first fill; never select a later correct call. If a complete stored role history never binds, NOT_CALLABLE. Missing role history is STORE SILENT.
operator_rule.rationale: Both initial directions right is A; one is C; neither F. Later revisions are disclosed, not punished merely for adapting. Exact family and timing remain diagnostics. No separate B/D boundary is needed.

MICRO.eligibility_rule: First in trace receipt order with a stored resolved P/Q/X sentence, finite Q and deadline, after own formation and inside the corrected span and bell. No future target participates in selection.
MICRO.deadline_rule: Stored absolute deadline_epoch, else original trace bell minus stored X; express that same instant on the corrected ruler clock. Never move a prediction when the ruler bell changes.
MICRO.remaining_rule: At every eligible receipt: minimum of carried accepted true print and strictly later accepted prints before corrected span end/bell. A carried minimum is timed at the receipt, not credited as a new print. Also score the future-print-only target separately.
MICRO.aggregation: Better of point and qualifying range per side; worst side. No call F. No verified floor STORE SILENT.

print_source.rule: Existing fit-local/prints.jsonl: true_print=true, finite price/time, positive size, receipt_id or trade_id. Duplicate identities per ticker are counted once; conflicting duplicates fail. exchange_ts uses the existing replay Date.parse millisecond clock; equal timestamps retain file order. No book last, interpolation, or synthetic print.

HANDS.age_rule: Lineage begins at PLACE, survives reprices, ends on remove/fill. Current-price age resets only on a level change. Same-second tests current-price start and fill timestamps, not rounded minute ages. Missing starts remain STORE SILENT.

OUTCOME.definition: Verified-span under-par completed-pair discount only; partial pair captures zero cents. Same-second conduct is graded separately.

ALT.note: Full-span floor premium retained even if floor already printed; queue/earlier maker fill is not assumed

GAS.note: Full-span floor premium retained even if floor already printed; queue/earlier maker fill is not assumed

rule.label: Actual trade near each full-span floor
rule.rationale: Both sides must meet the same tolerance. A 2c premium is B, including when the floor already printed. Preserve that fact; do not reset the target to a higher later floor, or apply a second penalty for the same overpay. Unknown queue means the missed earlier fill is not declared certain.

MACRO.label: Initial macro idea, not the pool's exact family name
MACRO.role_source: RECOGNITION_OPERATING_POINT @41c1f724: close minus post-formation open; >=+2 CLIMBER, <=-2 FALLER, else NOT_CALLABLE. Use corrected close/open, never stale net_travel.
MACRO.selection: First recorded directional first_bind inside the corrected span and no later than that side's first fill; never select a later correct call. If a complete stored role history never binds, NOT_CALLABLE. Missing role history is STORE SILENT.
MACRO.rationale: Both initial directions right is A; one is C; neither F. Later revisions are disclosed, not punished merely for adapting. Exact family and timing remain diagnostics. No separate B/D boundary is needed.

MICRO.label: First eligible floor call or a useful stored range
MICRO.range_rule: Same first eligible receipt's q25-q75 must contain the recorded floor and its q50, with ordered finite endpoints. Width = q75-q25. B width 4 is +/-2; C width 6 is +/-3. Range alone never earns A. Missing range does not erase an available Q score.
MICRO.aggregation: Better of point and qualifying range per side; worst side. No call F. No verified floor STORE SILENT.
MICRO.rationale: Do not cherry-pick later Q. Keep first-call and remaining-print timing/errors, oracle mean and its denominator visible; the receipt-weighted oracle mean includes post-fill forecasts and is not the preliminary objective.

TRADE.label: Actual trade near each full-span floor
TRADE.rationale: Both sides must meet the same tolerance. A 2c premium is B, including when the floor already printed. Preserve that fact; do not reset the target to a higher later floor, or apply a second penalty for the same overpay. Unknown queue means the missed earlier fill is not declared certain.

operator_review.basis: Operator preliminary goal: macro idea, floor or useful range, nearby trade, complete under par; not last-cent perfection or Gate-1 certification.
changes: Initial directional call is frozen before fill; later corrections and flip counts are disclosed, not cherry-picked or automatically penalized.
Same first eligible Q and bounded q25-q75 range; no later accurate call selection. Timing and oracle mean remain diagnostics, not preliminary letter cutoffs.
Both trades must satisfy the same full-span floor tolerance. An earlier floor keeps its 2c premium at B, without an invented queue fill or duplicate penalty.
PAIR uses offered-relative capture, not 97/99 absolute sums. No capture uplift; hard safety/named failures cannot be bought off.
Verified no-under-par-offer games are NOT OFFERED, not failed for no trade and not awarded a passing overall letter.
operator_review.new_cutoffs: Explicit v1 grading judgments in grade_rubric.json, not fitted on the five games. Price tolerances inherit counsel's 1/2/3c; band widths 4/6 are twice the corresponding 2/3c tolerance; 75%/50% capture thresholds are labeled grading choices.
operator_review.macro_prior_art: RECOGNITION_OPERATING_POINT @41c1f724; realized close minus post-formation open, +/-2c. Corrected columns, not cached net_travel.
operator_review.scope: No engine, pool, pricing, conduct, replay or population bench change.

bench_taxonomy_receipt.role: Realized family rule, inherited 17-point taxonomy plus declared bench choices.
bench_taxonomy_receipt.signature_method: per leg, T-minus axis normalized to the verified span [formation end -> bell]: forward-filled last-true-print path sampled at 17 points (leading value = post-formation open); features net/travel/maxstep/bigstep_share/early(first-quarter) net/late(last-quarter) net/reversals; families by stated rules in family() (rule order: SLEEPER, ROUND_TRIP/QUIET_WOBBLE if |net|<5, LATE_BREAK if last quarter >=70% of net, EARLY_SET if first quarter >=70% and flat after, ONE_STEP if one inter-sample step >=60% of net, GRIND_WOBBLE if >=4 reversals and travel>=2|net|, else DRIFT)

bench_choices.causal_family_adaptation: At a receipt only, normalize formation through the current gate into 17 samples; do not use or forward-fill into the unknown remainder. Realized labels use formation through bell.
bench_choices.direction: early/late shares are signed relative to net; reversals omit zero steps
bench_choices.flat_after: abs(net after first quarter) <= 2 cents; operator-authorized bench choice, not taxonomy law
bench_choices.quiet_wobble_prose_caveat: The inherited travel split does not mathematically guarantee the prose 5-cent band. quiet_wobble_prose_band_exception is exposed; no new cutoff is introduced.
bench_choices.sleeper: actual post-formation true-print count < category empirical p10; bench choice, not taxonomy law
bench_choices.small_net_branch: abs(net)<5: ROUND_TRIP if travel>=10; otherwise QUIET_WOBBLE; no extra band filter

No trace, face input, or OS call is changed.
rules.micro: First eligible stored resolved P/Q/X forecast in receipt order versus full recorded span; use its stored q25/q75 only for bounded range credit. Every receipt/remaining-path and strictly future-print score remains diagnostic, as do timing and receipt-weighted oracle mean. Never move a stored absolute deadline.
rules.hands_ages: Separate original PLACE lineage age from current-price age, resetting only the latter on price change; remove/fill ends the lineage. Fill same-second check uses the current-price start timestamp. The legacy chart age is preserved, not used as current-price duration.
